summary: REMOVE-HEALTH-INSIGHTS iteration PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 43/43 pytest cases green (6 new tests added for this iteration). Insights screen visually confirmed to render ONLY 'Patterns worth noticing' (1 weekday emerging pattern: 'Your mood has tended to be lower on Tuesdays.') and 'Context patterns' (3 early-signal context items — Money / Health / Work) plus the 7-day daily mood strip. critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_insights (line 343): correctly returns helps=[] and harder=[] as literal empty lists; only weekday-based notice (from reported mood) and context-tag patterns are computed. No sleep_minutes / steps / hrv / rhr correlations are referenced anywhere in the returned insight objects.
server.py today_observation (line 463): now sources exclusively from build_insights['context'] → build_insights['notice'] → mood-baseline delta. No health words possible in any branch.
server.py _story_template (line 940): removed 'sleep and movement' closing. Empty top_helps/top_harder lists simply skip those for-loops, so the template stays coherent for both week & month periods.
server.py /story facts: top_helps and top_harder derive from ins['helps'][:2] / ins['harder'][:1] which are now always []. Verified in test_story_template_no_sleep_and_movement.

insights.tsx: renderGroup is called only for ins.notice ('Patterns worth noticing') and ins.context ('Context patterns'). helps/harder are still kept in the local `ins` shape default and counted into `total` for the empty-state check — harmless because backend guarantees them empty.

Minor (non-blocking): insights.tsx line 27 destructures `helps: [], harder: []` in the fallback shape but never renders them; consider removing from the default to avoid confusion — spec-compliant either way.
